crossRefs.note: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth, and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.
The Philistines took God’s ark, and brought it into the house of Dagon and set it by Dagon.

translations.web: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.
translations.bsb: They put his armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of Dagon.
translations.kjv: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
translations.asv: And they put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.
